value.body: Design studios and agencies do design work for outside clients: brand identity, packaging, product, interior, digital and UX projects. Designers work in small teams on several projects at once, from briefs and concepts to final files, often presenting to clients. Studio size ranges from a few people to large multi-office firms.

items.label: Common entry role
items.value: Junior / associate designer or design intern

items.label: What hiring looks at
items.value: Portfolio, plus a design task or interview
items.note: Degree matters less than the work shown

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.Des or related degree helps, but studios hire mainly on the portfolio. Internships during the degree are a common route to a first job. Expect a portfolio review and often a short design exercise.

value.title: At a glance
items: Deadlines and client revisions can mean uneven, long hours.
Studio work builds range quickly; in-house teams offer more depth on one product or brand.
Growth runs from designer to senior designer, art or design director, or starting your own studio.
